label: CKPT_SAMPLER_INCONSISTENT
fix_claim: ckpt.save never stored the sampler position, so after the restart from ck0004 the sampler restarted at epoch 0 index 0 and replayed the already-consumed samples; I added the sampler state to the saved checkpoint so restore() (which already loads it) resumes at the correct position.
patch:
--- a/job/ckpt.py
+++ b/job/ckpt.py
@@ -42,4 +42,5 @@
                       for i, p in enumerate(model.parameters())})
         state.update(step=torch.tensor([step]))
+        state.update(sampler=sampler.state())
         torch.save(state, Path("ckpt", cid, "state.pt"))
         commit(cid, step, world_size)
